resonance-expansion-slot-description: [Workstation Material] Used to upgrade the Agent Workstation facility level.
resonance-expansion-slot-lore: A high-grade expansion slot used to upgrade Agent Workstation facilities.

resonance-hero-upgrade-core-lore: A high-grade hero upgrade core used to raise hero levels.
skill-desc-arts-ammo: Basics deal arts damage and deal increased damage for a duration.
skill-desc-arts-backflow: Briefly reduce magic damage taken and restore a small amount of HP.
skill-desc-arts-lock-barrage: Immediately strike the highest arts-defense enemy multiple times and bind them.
skill-desc-arts-ward-protocol: Raise magic defense for several seconds.
skill-desc-bandwidth-reclaim: Automatically refund a small amount of bandwidth on a short cycle.
skill-desc-dawn-glow: Raise attack speed and heal power.
skill-desc-diffusion-protocol: For a while, splash hits more nearby enemies.
skill-desc-dual-slaughter: For a few seconds: reach becomes two tiles forward, basics hit the two highest-HP enemies in range, and basic damage is increased.
skill-desc-expand-array: Widen range, hit two targets, raise attack speed, and slow enemies in range.
skill-desc-full-parse: Basics hit all enemies in range and gain attack speed for a duration.
skill-desc-global-armor: Briefly raise both physical and magic defense.
skill-desc-group-heal: Your next heal treats all allies in range once for a percent of your attack.
skill-desc-heal-overload: Faster attacks but lower heal power; healed allies gain temporary max HP.
skill-desc-heal-tide: Raise heal power and attack speed.
skill-desc-healing-rhythm: Temporarily raise attack speed and heal power.
skill-desc-hex-infusion: Empower your next basic attack and briefly raise attack speed.
skill-desc-holy-chant: Boost heal power, slow your cadence, multi-target heals, and convert heals into shields.
skill-desc-last-bulwark: Gain +1 intercept, restore HP to full, and gain a shield based on max HP.
skill-desc-light-blessing: Boost heals and speed, multi-target, and weaken the next hit of enemies blocked by healed allies.
skill-desc-over-heal: Your next heal also grants shields based on heal amount.
skill-desc-phys-protocol: Raise physical defense and immediately restore some HP.
skill-desc-priority-bind: Bind the highest-HP enemies in range. Locks 1 target, or 2 after skill level 4.
skill-desc-rapid-fire-protocol: Temporarily raise attack speed and physical attack.
skill-desc-recovery-field: Map-wide heals, multi-hit basics, and increased heal power.
skill-desc-revival-wind: Allies who fall in your range return to the deploy bench at full HP; their next deploy costs 0 bandwidth.
skill-desc-shatter-guard: For a short window, reduce physical damage taken.
skill-desc-soft-light: Heals multiple lowest-HP allies for a duration.
skill-desc-splash-overclock: Your next basic attack deals higher splash damage.
skill-desc-splash-overload: Your next basic attack deals higher splash damage.
skill-desc-volley: Basics hit multiple highest-HP targets for a duration.
